primary_title: Interleukin-7 promotes the survival of human CD4+ effector/memory T cells by up-regulating Bcl-2 proteins and activating the JAK/STAT signalling pathway
decision_basis: The review-guided primary shows IL-7 upregulates MCL1 in primary human CD4-positive effector/memory T cells, with JAK/STAT inhibition disrupting the IL-7 survival response.
limitations_preserved: Promote as a bounded IL-7-associated MCL1 survival-output bridge; preserve the human effector/memory T-cell context and distinguish output association from direct promoter occupancy.
